name: intellij-plugin-engineering
description: IntelliJ Platform plugin engineering workflow for repository-first implementation, Kotlin and Gradle proof, programmatic Starter/Driver UI tests, Plugin Verifier, Kast exact-root IDEA delivery, Git hygiene, pull requests, and CI.

metadata.dailyDriver: Install in Kotlin and Gradle repositories that build or maintain IntelliJ Platform plugins and need implementation through focused model or UI proof, packaging, PRs, and CI; the Kast playbook activates only in Kast.
metadata.notFor: End-user IDE configuration, greenfield scaffolding, generic Kotlin repositories without IntelliJ plugin code, copied SDK documentation, or bypassing repository-owned release and runtime authority.
metadata.packageBoundary: IntelliJ-specific decisions are owned by intellij-plugin-delivery; existing Kotlin, Gradle, TDD, Git, PR, and CI primitives retain their independent contracts.
metadata.scope: Repository-first IntelliJ Platform plugin development and delivery: descriptors, dependencies, lifecycle, threading, PSI/indexing, Gradle Plugin 2.x, Starter/Driver UI automation, verification, packaging, Kast exact-root IDEA readiness, Git, PRs, and CI.
